definition: the one circle that greens only on time with someone I care about

settled:
The love circle takes no credit for anything that serves the value only by name. It greens on time spent with people I care about with capacity to spare, which is a bid landing below my safety line rather than above it.

Only Jen supplies that time now. Every other relationship of mine has gone reactive, where I answer but do not reach, so none of them feeds this input at all.

So on a day with no such time the love circle cannot reach green, and neither can the whole panel. All-green is gated on one narrow channel, and it needs my capacity and her availability inside the same window.

title: The Light I Cannot Clear On My Own
